Okay, the SCIMITAR is still moving toward the northeast.
 
You and Tip are hurled from your seats as the SCIMITAR and the ship collide! The sub is up-ended and swept aside by the momentum of the ship. Thanks to the strength of your revolutionary hull design, the SCIMITAR is still okay, but its machinery is hopelessly damaged.
